prompt: A lively 1950s American diner counter, with a classic checkered floor. A shiny chrome stool is pulled up to the counter. The centerpiece is a large milkshake machine, with a full glass of milkshake and a straw sitting beside it. A napkin dispenser stands next to a ketchup bottle and a mustard dispenser. Further down, a glass sugar shaker, a pot of coffee, and a ceramic mug are ready for a customer. A printed menu is propped against a glass display case holding a slice of pie on a plate with a fork. A small service bell and a vintage cash register are at the end of the counter. A rotary phone is mounted on the wall next to a calendar. In the corner, a colorful jukebox is playing. The diner serves classic American fare, so you won't see any sushi or a slice of pizza. This is a classic establishment without modern technology like a flat-screen TV, a laptop, or a fancy espresso machine.
